scope: Real canonical Web email sign-in and user-activated cross-origin S256 consent to an owned loopback callback; actual token exchange and sign-out. Does not replace current Electron/MV3 first-exchange acceptance.

checks.name: real canonical 202/201 email login stays inside the product when given an external return target
a normal user click navigates to canonical GET consent, reaches the owned loopback with matching state and exchanges its S256 code for real 201 tokens
canonical browser sign-out clears both product cookies and safely accepts a repeated signed-out request
